data.heading: 1. Rabi Season harvest and Summer Season Sowing Status:
data.text:
-  As on May 01, 2026, the area sown under summer crops is 81.60 lakh ha as compared to 79.00 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.  Of this, area of 31.05 lakh ha has been sown under Rice this year.
-  As on 01.05.2026, 95.25% of area has been harvested for Rabi crops all over India. 100% area of Pulses has been completed; 99.87% area of Oilseeds majorly in Rapeseed & Mustard (100%); 96.22% area of Shri Anna cum Coarse Cereals majorly in Jowar (98.86%), 59.32% area of Rice and 97.00% area of Wheat has been harvested for rabi crops 2025-26.

data.heading: Week 1 (01  May - 07 May 2026):
data.text:
-  Gradual rise in maximum temperatures by 2-3°C likely over Northwest till 02nd May; gradual fall by 3-5°C during 03st -06th May.
-  Gradual fall in maximum temperatures by about 2°C likely over Central India till 01st May and no significant change during 02nd -06th May.
-  No significant change in maximum temperatures likely over rest parts of the country.
-  Heat  wave  conditions  very  likely  in  some  places  of  Vidarbha  on  30th  April  &  01st  May;  West Rajasthan on 02nd & 03rd May.

data.heading: Week 2 (08  May - 15 May 2026):
data.text:
-  Low  Probability  of  Heatwave  conditions  likely  during  some  days  of  week  2  over  Rajasthan  & Vidarbha,  and  adjoining  southern  parts  of  Madhya  Pradesh  and  Chhattisgarh.  Above-normal maximum temperatures (+1.6 to +3.0°C) are likely over many parts of Rajasthan and Gujarat, along the  west  coast,  and  over  Odisha  &  Coastal  Andhra  Pradesh  on  the  east  coast.  Below-normal maximum temperatures (-1.6 to -3.0°C) are likely over parts of Bihar, Jharkhand, and Gangetic West Bengal. Near-normal weekly maximum temperatures are likely over the rest of the country.
-  No warm night conditions are likely during the week.

data.heading: Rabi Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Rice : About 31.05 lakh ha area coverage under Summer Rice has been reported as compared to 32.42 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Pulses : About 23.49 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 22.76 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Oilseeds : About 11.04 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 9.58 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
